verdict.rationale: The reviewer's concern holds. Vast.ai documents Jupyter access, including a direct-connection option (vast-ai-docs-48, vast-ai-docs-65), and lists SSH or Jupyter as connection methods (vast-ai-docs-59). Its instance portal creates Cloudflare tunnels for open ports (vast-ai-docs-49), templates come Jupyter-ready (vast-ai-docs-62), and the connection overview mentions VS Code support (vast-ai-docs-63). However, no excerpt shows Jupyter opening or an IDE attaching in a single step, and one-click template launch is not the same as one-step access to the running instance. Missing for 10: a documented one-click Jupyter open or one-step VS Code/Cursor connect flow, any mention of Cursor, depth on the VS Code connection steps, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
